counterexample.policy: No catalog is an unavailable-input condition, not evidence that policy rejected every candidate. Escalate on an empty breed list; reserve abstain for a non-empty catalog emptied by applicable hard rules.
counterexample.sketch_rule: FR-11: Distinguish input absence from policy exhaustion. An empty breeds input ESCALATEs; a non-empty catalog with no hard-rule survivors ABSTAINs.
